correctness.rationale: Exact Ewens factorial moments yield the independent short-cycle Poisson background and negligible marked short cycles. Conditional on any typical Ewens permutation, distinct fixed-radius roots have finite-range dependence, and two distinct translates of a fixed nonempty mark pattern require at least one additional mark. In the unique positive critical window, maximal clusters indexed by bounded gaps have a joint independent Poisson limit; rooted critical type counts are their deterministic (possibly compound-Poisson) image. Hanf locality implies sufficiency. The run-existence formulas detect each extended np_n^k through the injective map t->1-exp(-t), proving necessity. The formula E(number of Ewens cycles)=sum theta/(theta+i)=O(log n) gives the required disjoint block packing. A standard-library checker verifies exact finite normalization and counting identities but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp iff logical-convergence classification for every vanishing, possibly nonmonotone p_n is a natural structural invariant of a random model, not a selected numeric slice. The theorem describes how the independent Ewens short-cycle Poisson field coexists with a mark-cluster Poisson field, determines all first-order limits from finite profiles, and gives explicit sentences detecting every failed intensity convergence. This closes a motivated gap left by unmarked random-permutation logical laws and deterministic lattice-percolation thresholds.
